# The Kane Academy

> The Kane Academy is basketball parent education for families of AAU and travel basketball players, founded by Coach Dennis Kane, a retired San Diego high school basketball coach.

## Who Coach Kane is

Dennis Kane is the founder and head coach of The Kane Academy. He retired as the 6th winningest boys basketball coach in San Diego high school history, with 440 career wins across 50 years of coaching. He placed 71 players in collegiate basketball, and won 10 league titles, 1 CIF title, with 6 CIF finals appearances and 4 state playoff bids. He now coaches parents directly, helping them support their child's basketball development without the common mistakes that undermine it.

## What The Kane Academy offers

A four-tier product ladder for parents, from free to full-season coaching:

1. **Court & Life Quotables** (Free) — Coach Kane's on-court and off-court principles, delivered via email opt-in. https://kaneacademy.sales.com/services/free-templates/
2. **The Playbooks** ($27) — Two ebooks (A Parent's Guide to AAU & Travel Basketball, with an NIL bonus section, and The Real Playbook For Basketball Parents) plus an 8-part audio series on engaging coaches effectively. https://kaneacademy.sales.com/services/playbooks/
3. **AAU Situation Audit** ($150) — A single 50-minute diagnostic call with Coach Kane, ending in three named priorities and a same-day written report. The fee credits toward the Parent Head Coach program if the family enrolls. https://kaneacademy.sales.com/services/audits/
4. **Parent Head Coach** ($1,000) — The flagship program: a season of guidance across four sessions (The Plan, The System, Navigation, The Review), including a custom 12-month development plan for the child and both Playbooks. https://kaneacademy.sales.com/1-on-1-calls/

## Notes

The Kane Academy is a standalone digital-product business and is not affiliated with, and does not share pricing or content with, any other basketball academy site bearing Coach Kane's name.
